item.title: Version 2.7.1
item.description: Caption Selects: caption just your selects from the workspace toolbar — priced up front, one click. Export fixes: JPG exports now keep your EXIF, GPS, and capture times; the export sheet remembers your last mode and the button says exactly what it will do (no more silent re-encodes when you wanted copies).

item.title: Version 2.7.0
item.description: Auto-updates arrive: the app now updates itself. Also in 2.7.0: Copy Keepers and drag-to-sidebar (the post-cull handoff), typed + voice reasoning notes with visible buttons, the three-tier Judge (The Eye, Brief Interpreter, Roast Slider), revision-aware visual clustering, correct date buckets in Sort into Folders, bundled exiftool, and the new app icon.
